scenario.title: Contacting an Online Store About an Order
scenario.description: You recently ordered a winter jacket from an online clothing store called Northline Outfitters. The package arrived quickly, but the jacket inside is a different size from the one you selected.
scenario.subject: Order #48213: incorrect size received
scenario.purpose: Report a shipping error and arrange an exchange
keyPoints: Mention what you liked about your experience with the store
Describe the problem with your order
Ask how you can get the correct item before a trip you have planned

modelAnswer:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I placed an order with your store for the first time last week, and I was impressed by how easy the website was to use. The package also arrived two days earlier than expected, which I really appreciated.

Unfortunately, when I opened the box, I found that the jacket was a size large, even though I chose a small. My order confirmation clearly shows the correct size, so I believe there was a mistake in the warehouse. The color and style are exactly what I wanted, so I would prefer an exchange rather than a refund.

I am leaving for a ski trip on December 15, so I would be grateful if the replacement could be sent as soon as possible. Could you tell me whether I should return the large jacket first, or whether both can be shipped at the same time?

Thank you,
Maya Chen

rubric.description: Shows appreciation, explains the size error with supporting detail, and asks a clear question about the exchange and timing.
Logical sequence from positive experience to problem to request, with a proper greeting and sign-off.
Courteous customer register; uses varied structures and avoids copying the task wording.
